authenticity_review: The image exhibits moderate structural artifacts that reduce authenticity. Flower stems terminate abruptly in mid-air without ground attachment (severity 2), creating an unnatural floating effect. Rabbit paws show mild melting/lack of toe definition where they contact the surface (severity 2). Motorcycle rear wheel shows slight perspective distortion (severity 1). These issues indicate AI generation flaws but do not completely destroy object recognizability. The high-quality rendering of the motorcycle and rabbit face partially compensates for these defects.
